description: This file contains functions for processing and removing effect tokens from a PyTorch FX graph, including replacing nodes, handling subgraphs, and updating graph signatures within an exported program.

methods.name: _get_custom_obj_for_node
methods.description: Extracts a custom object from a node based on its metadata and arguments.

methods.name: _replace_with_effects_node
methods.description: Replaces a with_effects node with its underlying function call, updating metadata and handling return values.

methods.name: _replace_invoke_subgraph_node
methods.description: Replaces an invoke_subgraph node to remove the token argument and update getitem nodes.

methods.name: _remove_effect_tokens
methods.description: Removes effect tokens from an exported program, updating the graph and signature accordingly.
